answer_1.quote: Video captioning is a challenging cross-modal task that aims to describe videos with natural language sentences.

answer_2.quote: We test the correlation between automatic metrics and human annotation...

answer_4.quote: we hire three graduate students as our annotators. We provide them with a detailed instruction document and several annotation examples so that they can fully understand the annotation protocol.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to give three levels of factuality annotation for each video caption. Paragraph-level: give a factuality Likert scale from 1 to 5; Sentence-level: label 1 if the sentence has factual errors, else 0; Word-level: mark phrases and words that have factual errors.
